info.title: HeatGuard AI API
info.description:
Backend for **HeatGuard AI**: personalised, privacy-preserving heat-risk decision support for outdoor workers.
Risk levels come from the external HeatGuard AI engine; this API stores context, calls the engine, and serves the
worker app and the supervisor dashboard.

### How to try it here
1. Open **auth** → `POST /auth/login` → *Try it out*, with `{ "loginId": "S-001", "pin": "1234" }`
   (demo logins: supervisor `S-001`, workers `W-0301` to `W-0508`, occupational health `O-001`).
2. Copy `accessToken`, click **Authorize** (top right) and paste it. It is remembered while this page is open.
3. Call any endpoint. Each one says **who can call it** at the top of its description.

Access tokens last 15 minutes; get a new one with `POST /auth/refresh`.

### Roles
| Role | Uses |
|---|---|
| `worker` | The worker app: own risk, consent, health profile, symptom reports, water, band, data rights |
| `supervisor` | The supervisor dashboard: site and crew risk (levels and actions only), plans, measures |
| `occupational_health` | Back-office only (no frontend screen): precaution levels, symptom details. Every read is audited |
| `admin` | Sites, crews, workers, accounts and PINs |

### Conventions
- **Raw data, not text:** codes (`en`, `high_priority`, `heart`), IDs and numbers. The app turns them into words.
- **Times** are ISO 8601 in UTC; show them in the site's timezone (`site.timezone`, e.g. `Africa/Lagos`).
- **Risk levels:** 1 Low, 2 Elevated, 3 High, 4 Critical. Use the number for logic; `label` is in the worker's language.
- **Errors:** `{ "statusCode": 400, "message": "...", "error": "Bad Request" }`. 401 = not logged in or token expired;
  403 = your role can't do this; 404 = not found; 409 = conflicts with the current state (e.g. "Already clocked in");
  503 = a feature switch is off or a dependency is down.

### Privacy (enforced by the server)
Supervisors never receive engine `reasons`, precaution levels, health answers, symptoms or band readings.
Health data and band readings are encrypted at rest. Reads of a worker's private data are audited and shown to the
worker in `GET /me/access-log`.

### Feature switches (server settings)
`WEARABLES_ENABLED`, `ENGINE_SUPPORTS_WEARABLES`, `ENGINE_SUPPORTS_HOOD`, `ENGINE_WBGT_ENABLED`,
`WEATHER_POLLING_ENABLED`. Endpoints behind a switch that is off answer 503.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Log in with an ID and PIN; refresh the access token.

tags.name: me
tags.description: The signed-in person: profile, shift, consents, preferences, water tracker, app heartbeat, "Who looked at your data".

tags.name: risk
tags.description: Risk levels from the AI engine: the worker's own view, the supervisor-safe site overview, running assessments, engine rules.

tags.name: recommendations
tags.description: Recommended actions for the worker (from the engine) and for supervisors (rule-based, health-free).

tags.name: interventions
tags.description: Record what was done about a recommendation: acknowledged, implemented, reassigned, dismissed.

tags.name: help-requests
tags.description: "Alert first aider" and symptom reports. Supervisors see who needs help, never the symptoms.

tags.name: supervisor
tags.description: The supervisor Today page in one call, the crews table and the last-days history.

tags.name: shift-plan
tags.description: Crew x hour plan, the too-hot rule, the suggested plan, "Send to crews".

tags.name: measures
tags.description: Safety and productivity measures, crew-level only. Some figures are provisional.

tags.name: workload
tags.description: Activities, work assignments, and clock-in / break / clock-out (the engine needs them).

tags.name: wearables
tags.description: Optional wristband (heart rate, skin temperature). Off unless WEARABLES_ENABLED=true; needs consent.

tags.name: health-profiles
tags.description: Worker's private health answers, consents and data rights (export, erase). Occupational health sets precaution levels.

tags.name: environment
tags.description: Weather, WBGT and site sensor readings.

tags.name: workers
tags.description: Worker records (no health data) and acclimatisation start dates.

tags.name: ppe
tags.description: Protective equipment catalogue and what each worker wears.

tags.name: sites
tags.description: Sites (location, timezone, shifts, emergency number) and crews.

tags.name: audit
tags.description: Who accessed sensitive data, and when.

metadata.description: Never put health data in here.

loginId.description: Login ID. For workers it defaults to their employee code (e.g. W-0412).

emergencyNumber.description: Shown on the worker Report screen as a tap-to-call number.

shifts.description: Named shifts in site-local time, e.g. Day shift 07:00 to 17:00.

supervisorUserId.description: User responsible for this crew (role: supervisor).

employeeCode.description: Employer's own identifier for the worker.

readAloud.description: "Read warnings aloud" preference from My data.

acclimatizationStartedOn.description:
When the worker started working regularly in this heat (decision D4).
`acclimatized` is derived from it (see acclimatization.ts); null = unknown,
treated as not acclimatised. Work history, not health data.

leftOn.description: Date the worker left the site; health data is erased 30 days later.

acclimatizationStartedOn.description: When the worker started working regularly in this heat. Unknown = not acclimatised.

isActive.description: false = left the site (starts the 30-day retention clock)

startedOn.description: New start date. Today = "returned after an absence".

reason.description: Required when moving the date earlier (makes the engine less cautious).

observedAt.description: Time the conditions apply to (observation time or forecast hour).

wbgtModel.description: Name of the estimation formula used, for traceability.

heatIllness.description: Past heat illness answer: no | recent | old | unsure.

acclimatisationAnswer.description:
"How long in this heat?" answer: new | adjusting | over2 | back.
It also sets the worker's acclimatisation start date (decision D4).

restrictions.description: Work restrictions set by occupational health, one per line (shown to the worker).

precautionNotes.description: Restrictions written by occupational health (free text, encrypted).

precautionLevel.description: Set ONLY by occupational health. Supervisors see its effect, not its basis.

reviewRequested.description: Worker changed their data or asked for a review; occupational health must look again.

acclimatisation.description: Also sets the acclimatisation start date (the later, more cautious date wins).

example: No heavy work at level 3 and above
restrictions.description: Work restrictions, shown to the worker (never to supervisors)

organizationId.description: Null = global catalogue entry; otherwise organisation-specific.

engineClass.description: Engine clothing class. Null for items the engine does not model (helmets, hoods, …).

engineAddon.description: Worn on top of the clothing and adds heat burden (e.g. a hood). Helmets: null.

engineClass.description: Risk-engine clothing class. Leave empty for items the engine does not model (e.g. helmets).

engineAddon.description: Set for items worn on top of the clothing that add heat burden, e.g. hoods. Not for helmets.

workloadOverride.description: Overrides the category default when the supervisor knows better.

plannedBreaks.description: Planned rest breaks in shade (start times). Feeds `rest_break` in engine forecasts.

breakMinutes.description: Length of each planned break in shade.

onBreakSince.description: Set while the worker is on a break; cleared when the break ends.

plannedBreaks.description: Planned rest breaks in shade (ISO start times within the shift)

policyVersion.description: Version of the privacy notice shown

crews.description: crewId → one task per hour (H, M, L or B), same length as the plan hours

deviceId.description: Band ID from the phone (or SIM-… for the simulator)
